Shop My Account Individual Giving DONATE Individual Giving Your charitable contributions help defray the cost of our 16 summer performances in Pinkney Park, Rowayton, as well as our year-round education program.
Our ticket prices do not cover the total expense of our summer productions.
Each year we must raise at least $115,000 from supporters like you to maintain our low ticket prices.
Please help us to continue our mission of providing affordable, professional Shakespeare productions to our community.
Your tax-deductible gift of any amount will be most appreciated.
Please contact our Managing Director, Lorah Haskins, if you have questions: Lorah@ShakespeareOnTheSound.org .
DONATE If you prefer to donate via check, you may mail your tax-deductible contribution to: Shakespeare on the Sound, Inc.
Box 15 Norwalk, CT 06853 Shakespeare on the Sound is a tax-exempt 501(c)(3) non-profit corporation.
All donations are fully tax deductible provided that no goods or services were provided in exchange for the donation.
